name: manim-slides-preview
description: Render manim-slides scenes, auto-convert them to interactive offline HTML, and live-preview them inside VS Code or any browser. Zero dependencies, fully offline.

commands.title: Manim Slides: Open Preview in Browser
Manim Slides: Present in Native Window (GUI)
Manim Slides: Clear Cache (force full re-render)

manimSlidesPreview.command.description: Executable used for rendering/converting. Examples: 'manim-slides', 'py -m manim_slides', '/usr/bin/manim-slides', 'C:\\Python313\\Scripts\\manim-slides.exe'.

manimSlidesPreview.ffmpegPath.description: Full path to your installed ffmpeg binary (e.g. 'C:\\ffmpeg\\bin\\ffmpeg.exe' or '/usr/bin/ffmpeg'). Its folder is prepended to PATH and exported as FFMPEG_BINARY for all render/convert/present commands, so Manim and manim-slides use YOUR ffmpeg instead of any bundled/other copy. Leave empty to use whatever 'ffmpeg' is already on PATH.

manimSlidesPreview.useDaemon.description: Keep a persistent background Python process that imports manim once and renders every save in-process — eliminates interpreter startup + import time (~1-3s per save, more on Windows). Falls back to normal subprocess automatically if it can't start.

manimSlidesPreview.pythonCommand.description: Python interpreter for the render daemon (e.g. 'py', 'python3.13', 'C:\\Python313\\python.exe', or a venv's python). Empty = 'python' on Windows, 'python3' elsewhere. Must be the same environment where manim-slides is installed.

manimSlidesPreview.turboPreview.description: Fastest possible preview iterations: renders at 640x360@15fps and skips generating reversed videos (stepping backwards in the preview replays the forward clip instead). Cuts cold renders ~25-40% and warm saves ~25%. Preview-only — turn OFF (or render with -qh) for final output. Worker processes are always capped at cpu_count-1 so your machine stays responsive.

enumDescriptions: Manim default (medium) — smallest files, slowest encode
~2x faster encoding, moderately larger files (recommended for previews)
manimSlidesPreview.x264Preset.description: x264 encoder preset injected at the PyAV level for ALL renders through the extension (every quality). Faster presets trade file size for encoder speed — visual quality stays the same (CRF-controlled). Turbo mode always uses 'ultrafast' regardless. Requires the render daemon.

manimSlidesPreview.cache.description: Use Manim's partial-movie cache so unchanged animations are reused between renders (only edited animations re-render), and skip the HTML convert + browser reload entirely when nothing changed. Disable if you suspect stale output; or run 'Manim Slides: Clear Cache' once instead.

manimSlidesPreview.quality.description: Render quality flag passed to manim.

manimSlidesPreview.renderOnSave.description: Automatically re-render + re-convert + refresh the preview every time you save (Ctrl+S) a file that has already been previewed once.

manimSlidesPreview.offline.description: Pass --offline to 'manim-slides convert' so the HTML presentation bundles Reveal.js locally and works with no internet (requires manim-slides >= 5.1.10).

manimSlidesPreview.oneFile.description: Pass --one-file so the presentation is a single self-contained HTML file (bigger file, slower convert — useful for sharing).

manimSlidesPreview.htmlControls.description: Show clickable Reveal.js arrow controls in the HTML presentation (-ccontrols=true).

manimSlidesPreview.extraRenderArgs.description: Extra CLI args appended to 'manim-slides render' (forwarded to manim).

manimSlidesPreview.extraConvertArgs.description: Extra CLI args appended to 'manim-slides convert'.

manimSlidesPreview.port.description: Preferred port for the built-in live-reload preview server (auto-increments if busy).

enumDescriptions: Default external browser — snappable window, shareable as a tab in Google Meet, auto-refreshes on save
Simple Browser tab inside VS Code, beside your code, auto-refreshes on save
Native Python GUI window (PySide6, 'manim-slides present') — full presenter hotkeys, OS window snapping; relaunches with fresh slides on save
VS Code tab + native GUI window
Don't auto-open anything; use the status bar / commands
manimSlidesPreview.openIn.description: Preview target(s) opened after the first successful render. HTML targets (browser/vscode) silently refresh on every save; the GUI window is relaunched with the fresh slides on save (needs 'pip install manim-slides[pyside6]').

manimSlidesPreview.guiArgs.description: Extra arguments for the native GUI presenter ('manim-slides present'), e.g. ["--fullscreen"], ["--hide-mouse"], ["-S", "2"] for a specific screen, ["--aspect-ratio", "keep"].

manimSlidesPreview.pptxExport.description: Auto-export a PowerPoint (.pptx) next to your scene file: created on the first ▶ render, silently kept up to date on every changed Ctrl+S. Runs in the background through the warm daemon — the preview is never delayed — and skipped when the slides didn't change. Set to false to disable.

manimSlidesPreview.pptxPath.description: Where to write the .pptx. Empty = '<scene file's folder>/<filename>.pptx'. A folder path puts '<filename>.pptx' inside it; a path ending in .pptx is used as-is. Relative paths resolve against the scene file's folder.

manimSlidesPreview.pptxArgs.description: Extra arguments for 'manim-slides convert --to pptx', e.g. ["-cwidth=1920", "-cheight=1080"] or ["-cauto_play_media=false"].
